chunks: Abu Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Abi Shaykh.

key_terms.أَبُو: A kunyah meaning 'father of,' used as an honorific personal designation.
key_terms.أَبِي شَيْخٍ: A familial designation meaning 'father of Shaykh,' used here as part of the lineage name.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A theophoric personal name meaning servant of Allah.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: The personal name Muhammad, identifying the kunyah Abu Muhammad.

ai.seo_question: Who is Abu Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Abi Shaykh in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This text is a biographical name entry referring to Abu Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Abi Shaykh. It does not contain a hadith matn, legal ruling, or theological teaching, but serves as an identification of a person within the context of the shaykhs listed in the work.
